{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mantooine government''' was the ruling legislature of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperially]]-aligned, the government had effectively ceded control of the planet's countryside to the [[Mantooine Liberators]], a ground force assigned to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Atrivis Sector Force]].
